comments.author: @AnaKhaietska
comments.text: AI voicing is annoying. I hate it so much. :( You look for something interesting and end up hearing the *** ai over and over again.

replies.author: @WorldsinStone
replies.text: Totally hear you — AI narration isn’t for everyone. We use it right now so we can keep episodes long-form and consistent while the channel grows, but we’re always working on making the voice sound more natural. Appreciate you sticking around despite it!
